BR-P-shipments.statement: shipment_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid

BR-P-tracking_events.statement: event_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid

BR-P-vehicles.statement: vehicle_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid

BR-P-routes.statement: route_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid

BR-P-carrier_bookings.statement: booking_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid

BR-P-ai_invocations.statement: ai_call_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid

BR-01.statement: the same business event is recorded once

BR-02.statement: sequence_no is unique within a shipment

BR-03.statement: a vehicle position older than the limit is stale and must not drive assignment; the dataset has no position timestamp (data gap); limit is an ASSUMPTION

BR-04.statement: event_time is interpreted in a valid declared time zone

BR-05.statement: a shipment has at most one active carrier booking

BR-06.statement: a route in a restricted zone is not assigned without an explicit override; the dataset has no override field (data gap)

BR-07.statement: location and driver identity are exposed only to personas and purposes listed in the access semantics

BR-09.statement: fuel level is a fraction between 0 and 1

BR-11.statement: timestamps are real; 1900-01-01 is a placeholder and invalid

BR-12.statement: a booking refers to an existing shipment

BR-13.statement: retries are bounded (limit is an ASSUMPTION; observed 51 to 4995)
